name: zen-cad
description: Assembly-first CAD contract skills packaged for Codex installs.

interface.shortDescription: Assembly-first CAD contracts, source-lock evidence, and handoffs.
interface.longDescription: Zen CAD packages CAD-native assembly contract workflows for mechanical design agents. It produces layout contracts, source-lock evidence for standard parts, proceed gates, review bundles, and downstream CAD handoffs without pretending to replace CAD kernels or engineering certification.
defaultPrompt: Create a CAD-native assembly contract for a compact belt-drive module.
Create source-lock evidence for a sourced STEP part.
Package an approved handoff for CAD Skills/text-to-cad.
